criteria.title: Loading & profiling
criteria.description: Data loaded correctly; shape, types and summary produced; the dataset is described accurately in the student's own words.

criteria.title: Cleaning decisions & justification
criteria.description: Defects found. Each handling decision stated AND justified. Marks are for the justification - an unjustified correct fix scores roughly half.

criteria.title: Visualisation
criteria.description: Three charts, each captioned with the question it answers. Correct chart type. Axes labelled with units. No decoration without purpose.

criteria.title: Findings
criteria.description: Five findings, supported by evidence from the data, stated with correct magnitudes and units. A wrong number loses the mark even if the method was right.

criteria.title: Engineering interpretation
criteria.description: One recommendation that an engineer could act on, plus a clear statement of what further data would be needed.

criteria.title: Clarity & reproducibility
criteria.description: Notebook runs top to bottom. Logical order. Markdown explains intent. No dead code.
